name: Ibutamoren (MK-677)
description: Small non-peptide molecule taken by mouth that mimics ghrelin

note.lead: One hip fracture trial was stopped.
note.text: It was stopped early for a safety signal of congestive heart failure; FDA cites this in its Category 2 listing.

bullets: **Mimics ghrelin** at the growth hormone secretagogue receptor
**Pituitary releases** more growth hormone, raising IGF-1
**IGF-1 rose** 73% to 84% in the Alzheimer's and hip fracture trials
**For sleep,** the effect rests on one small 1997 study
Placebo RCTs in older adults and patients

notEstablished.text: Effect on sleep in larger trials

practical.soldAs: “Research use only” (not legal for human use)
practical.monitored: GH, IGF-1, glucose, insulin sensitivity, function

references: FDA, Category 2 bulk drug substances (significant safety risks), Apr 2026
Nass et al., Ann Intern Med, ibutamoren in older adults, Nov 2008
Copinschi et al., Neuroendocrinology, MK-677 and sleep, Oct 1997
